purpose: Local Kubernetes platform stack with shared workflows and multiple adapters.

actions.intent: Run the full local gate before opening a push connection; pre-push reuses its exact-tree receipt.
actions.recovery: Read the failed owner job; repair its source or declared prerequisite, then rerun the full local gate. Fixture acceptance does not authorize cloud/device deployment.

actions.intent: Re-evaluate the retained domain decision using its owning regression/contract.
actions.recovery: Inspect the named source/test and reproduce the failing synthetic case before reusing this lesson.

actions.intent: Observe only installed kind, configured node image and public upstream identities; avoids unrelated app/cluster survey.
actions.recovery: Check empty identity fields and stderr. This observes public metadata and local configuration only; it never establishes deployed cluster state.

actions.intent: Verify the optional Backstage adapter with immutable dependencies, real backend/frontend consumers and complete build. Core CLI gates do not install the npm product.
actions.recovery: Use the declared supported Node22/24 engine and pinned Yarn. Do not replace missing dependencies with arbitrary latest installs; inspect consumer failures.

actions.intent: Validate the actual IDP catalog and nested type/reference regression fixtures offline.
actions.recovery: Inspect invalid_schema/invalid_payload/external_refs_disabled and repair the exact source; external refs cannot access network or files.

learning.summary: A full local gate receipt binds exact source bytes and environments, survives an unchanged commit, and refuses any edit; five formerly failed YAML checks require locked declared PyYAML rather than transient downloads. Full-gate skip and recursion requests refuse instead of producing success; dry-run remains observation only. The installed push shim also refuses missing Lefthook, explicit disable requests and metadata crashes; a disposable Git transport fixture proves no new remote ref is published.

Use --kind-only for kind identity decisions. The full component survey also audits every app and exceeded the former 300-second kind fixture deadline; its results cannot be substituted for narrow kind evidence.

Core policy/CLI modules and browser IDP SDK need no npm packages. Backstage is an optional product adapter; package discovery means absent frontend imports do not prove unused plugins. Only three proved unused declarations were removed; eight lock resolutions disappeared with no additions/upgrades. Preserve the registered OAuth2Proxy and GitHub scaffolder owners.

Required/const-only validation falsely accepted applications:false and missing nested catalog fields. Use the mature Draft 2020-12 adapter, enforce nested types and internal refs, and refuse all external refs through a closed loader. This tool-only dependency protects the catalog boundary without adding packages to product CLI modules.
